common.brand.context: footer line of every page of every document

common.page.context: page number in the footer: page of pages

common.watermark.context: diagonal watermark of a sample document: the same bilingual text in both languages (stub offer or demo data)

common.notice_stub.context: footer notice while the offer of the order is a placeholder (R-25)

common.notice_demo.context: footer notice on a document built on demo data

common.pending.context: placeholder for a requisite of the sole proprietor that does not exist yet (the IP is not registered): 'after registration'

requisites.title.context: heading of the block with the account of the sole proprietor

requisites.note.context: line under the requisites: the money for purchases goes to the account of the IP only

requisites.purpose.context: label before the purpose of the payment

requisites.purpose_default.context: standard purpose of the payment when the owner has not written his own; {number} is the number of the order; 'without VAT' at the end

requisites.fee_channel.context: line under the requisites: the fee is paid by QR Xolis with a receipt, a different flow of money
